semantic.justification: Original ScCellFormat first GetString overload resets color,selects actual context and dispatches empty/numeric/shared-string/formula values through real NFGetOutputString. Preserves zero suppression,formula output,error-before-empty/value ordering and the current native no-macro interpreter-level ellipsis path. Current core admits macro level0 only;macro/running callbacks,rich text,coordinate overload and other format families remain unported. Default formula grammar resolves to the real formula document grammar. No browser formatting,alternate cells or fake formatter services are introduced.
